section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes a study involving the translation of the BSRS into Brazilian Portuguese and data collection from university campus participants. Participants completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires with counterbalanced measure presentation, and physical measurements (weight, height, bra size) were taken. A subsample of 100 participants returned 15 days later for retest administration.
